# Crypto Beginner

> Free, beginner-friendly education platform for learning cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, blockchain, Web3, wallets, DeFi, NFTs and digital assets — plus live market data. No financial advice.

## Docs

- [Learn](https://cryptobeginner.in/learn): Structured lessons across Beginner, Intermediate, and Security tracks.
- [Dictionary](https://cryptobeginner.in/dictionary): Plain-English glossary of crypto and blockchain terms.
- [Blog](https://cryptobeginner.in/blog): Articles on crypto news, guides, and explainers.
- [Dashboard](https://cryptobeginner.in/): Live top-10 cryptocurrency prices, market stats, and news.
